note.markdown:
# Trading note: week of 16-22 Nov

## Contribution
Contribution after ads was $34.0k, down 18.7% on the prior week and 35.8% below the pre-Black-Friday weekly average of $53.0k. Contribution margin fell to 23.5%, from 34.8%.

From the $53.0k average, in order of impact:
- **Discounts cost $15.3k.** EARLYBF20 (20% off, in use since 2 Nov) was applied to 47.8% of orders, taking the discount rate to 10.7% against 1.6%.
- **Ad spend added $7.2k** of cost.
- Refunds took $2.8k, product cost $2.3k, and fulfilment, fees and return labels $2.2k.
- Higher gross sales (+$9.4k) and shipping charged (+$1.4k) offset part of this.

Net revenue was $144.8k, down 10.0% on last week, on 1,538 orders (13.3% above the baseline).

## Paid acquisition
Meta CPM was $20.69 against a $13.77 average before November, and Meta CAC rose to $80.60 from $56.07. After $21.7k of spend, Meta contributed -$8.9k this week, against +$4.6k a week before. Meta's own reporting claims 1.35x the orders Shopify attributes to it, so the platform view will look better than this. Blended paid CAC was $71.4.

## Returns
Linen Duvet Cover - Queen (NG-214) is being returned at 20.4% for orders placed since 26 Oct, against 5.5% before. The leading reason is "Colour not as pictured". The timing suggests something changed around that date, such as a new batch, photo or listing; the data does not show which.

## Stock
Cast Iron Skillet 10in (NG-101) has been out of stock for 5 days. At its prior run rate that is about 261 units, or $16.7k of gross sales. A purchase order for 900 units is expected on 30 Nov.

## For discussion
- Whether 20% is the right discount depth for the remaining weeks, given it is the largest single driver of the decline.
- Capping Meta prospecting while CPM stays near $20.69, or moving budget toward email and retargeting.
- Pausing NG-214 in ads until the supplier confirms the cause of the colour complaints.
- A back-in-stock waitlist for NG-101, and whether the 30 Nov delivery can be brought forward.

Prepared from warehouse data; figures reviewed by <reviewer> before circulation.
